svg.text: A3 – Mobile Background Design Pattern — console output capture

g.text: SENSOR: state=buffers/battery/permission; choose sample/batch/skip; undo=stop listener/flush buffer.
SYNC: state=dirty records/network/backlog; choose upload/defer/resolve; undo=rollback partial batch/release locks.
PUSH: state=pending messages/token/Doze/DND; choose deliver/delay/collapse; undo=cancel alarm/remove stale notification.
COMMON: event-driven constrained state; observe -> choose -> feasibility test -> commit/defer -> undo/retry.
Without undo, partial uploads may be marked synced incorrectly; lingering listeners/wakelocks drain battery.
